natural: a tiny flaw in white jade

meaning.en: A small flaw in an otherwise excellent thing.
meaning.zh: 洁白的美玉上有一点小瑕疵，比喻很好的事物里有小缺点。

examples.zh: 这篇作文写得很好，只是有个错别字，真是白玉微瑕。
examples.en: The essay is very good, with only one wrong character: a tiny flaw in white jade.

examples.zh: 这件作品堪称完美，唯一的白玉微瑕是包装。
examples.en: The work is nearly perfect and the only blemish is the packaging.

examples.zh: 别为白玉微瑕就否定整件事。
examples.en: Don't dismiss the whole thing because of one small flaw.

usage.en: Used to point out a minor fault while praising the whole. Similar to 美中不足 (which is the everyday phrase) but more literary. Also written 白璧微瑕.
usage.zh: 指整体很好而略有小缺点，比“美中不足”更书面。也作“白璧微瑕”。

synonyms: 西施掉了门牙——美中不足

natural: a commoner who is a minister in all but name

meaning.en: A scholar without office who is as respected as a minister.
meaning.zh: 没有官职的读书人，却受到公卿般的敬重；也指才华足以做宰相的布衣。

examples.zh: 柳永自称白衣卿相，意思是才子词人自有地位。
examples.en: Liu Yong called himself a minister in a white robe, meaning a talented poet has his own standing.

examples.zh: 他虽无官职，却是人人敬重的白衣卿相。
examples.en: He holds no office but is a respected scholar.

examples.zh: 寒门学子也有机会成为白衣卿相。
examples.en: Students from poor families can also earn respect as scholars.

story.en: Liu Yong wrote after failing the exam: 'Talented poets are themselves ministers in white robes' (才子词人，自是白衣卿相).
story.zh: 柳永《鹤冲天》：“才子词人，自是白衣卿相。”

usage.en: 白衣 refers to the plain clothes of those without official rank. Literary. Used as praise for talented commoners or in self-assertion by scholars who failed the exams.
usage.zh: “白衣”指没有官职的人所穿的衣服；书面语，赞扬有才的平民或读书人自重。

natural: seeing a ghost in broad daylight

meaning.en: Something strange and impossible, or lies that are plainly absurd.
meaning.zh: 大白天见到鬼，比喻怪事、不可能的事，或荒唐的谎话。

examples.zh: 你说他会借钱给你？简直白日见鬼！
examples.en: You say he will lend you money? That is impossible!

examples.zh: 听了他的解释，我觉得像白日见鬼一样荒唐。
examples.en: After his explanation I found it absurd, like seeing a ghost in daylight.

examples.zh: 这种怪事真是白日见鬼。
examples.en: Such a strange affair is like seeing a ghost at noon.

usage.en: Colloquial exclamation of disbelief; can also describe an event too odd to be true. Similar to 活见鬼.
usage.zh: 口语感叹，表示难以置信；与“活见鬼”相近。

natural: the blue bird brings attentive tidings

meaning.en: A go-between or messenger who diligently carries news, especially between lovers.
meaning.zh: 青鸟是传说中西王母的信使，比喻热心传递消息的使者，多指为恋人传信。

examples.zh: 他请朋友青鸟殷勤，帮他把信带给远方的她。
examples.en: He asked his friend to be a faithful messenger and take his letter to her far away.

examples.zh: 有了青鸟殷勤，两人的音信从未断过。
examples.en: With a faithful messenger, the two never lost touch.

examples.zh: 古诗里常说青鸟殷勤，来表达对远方人的思念。
examples.en: Old poems often use the blue bird to express longing for someone far away.

story.en: Li Shangyin ends: 'The magic isle is not far; blue bird, kindly go and look for me' (蓬山此去无多路，青鸟殷勤为探看).
story.zh: 李商隐《无题》：“蓬山此去无多路，青鸟殷勤为探看。”

usage.en: A poetic allusion to the blue bird, messenger of the Queen Mother of the West in myth. Literary; used for romantic messages and matchmaking.
usage.zh: 借用西王母信使青鸟的传说，书面语，多用于情书或说媒。

natural: planting jade at Lantian

meaning.en: A fortunate marriage; originally the story of a man who planted stones that became jade and won a wife.
meaning.zh: 杨伯雍在蓝田种石得玉并娶得佳偶的传说，比喻缔结美满姻缘。

examples.zh: 他们的婚事如同蓝田种玉，人人称羡。
examples.en: Their marriage was like planting jade at Lantian, and everyone envied it.

examples.zh: 传说杨伯雍蓝田种玉，得到了美满的姻缘。
examples.en: Legend says Yang Boyong planted jade at Lantian and won a happy marriage.

examples.zh: 婚礼上，有人用蓝田种玉来祝福新人。
examples.en: At the wedding someone used the Lantian jade story to bless the couple.

story.en: In the Soushen ji, Yang Boyong gave water to travellers; one gave him stones to plant, which became jade, and with it he won the hand of a noble's daughter.
story.zh: 《搜神记》载杨伯雍以义浆济人，得神人赠石种，后生白璧，聘得佳妇。

usage.en: Allusion for a fortunate marriage; not to be confused with 蓝田生玉 (a gifted son from a good family). Literary, mainly in wedding greetings and old writings.
usage.zh: 指喜结良缘；与“蓝田生玉”（名门出贤子）不同。书面语，多用于婚礼祝福。

natural: Lantian produces jade

meaning.en: A gifted child born to a distinguished family; fine stock produces fine sons.
meaning.zh: 蓝田盛产美玉，比喻名门出贤子，或父母优秀，子女出众。

equivalents: a gifted son of a good family
a chip off the old block

examples.zh: 他父亲是名医，他又聪明过人，真是蓝田生玉。
examples.en: His father is a famous doctor and he is very clever: fine stock produces fine sons.

examples.zh: 人们都说这孩子蓝田生玉，将来必有出息。
examples.en: People say this child comes from fine stock and will go far.

examples.zh: 蓝田生玉并非偶然，家风是关键。
examples.en: It is no accident that good families produce good children; family tradition counts.

story.en: In the Sanguozhi annotation, Sun Quan jokes that Zhuge Ke is the fine jade of Lantian, a gifted son of a gifted family.
story.zh: 《三国志·吴书·诸葛瑾传》裴松之注引《江表传》：孙权称诸葛恪“蓝田生玉，真不虚也”。

usage.en: Praise for a young person and their parents. Different from 蓝田种玉 (marriage). Literary and rare in modern speech.
usage.zh: 称赞少年及其父母，与“蓝田种玉”（喜结良缘）不同；书面语，现代少用。

natural: summer rain waters the people

meaning.en: To benefit others as the summer rain nourishes crops; generous help.
meaning.zh: 夏天的雨滋润万物，比喻给人及时的恩惠和帮助。

examples.zh: 好官夏雨雨人，百姓感激不尽。
examples.en: A good official brings benefits like summer rain and the people are grateful.

examples.zh: 老师对学生春风风人，夏雨雨人。
examples.en: The teacher shows his pupils kindness like spring wind and summer rain.

examples.zh: 他的捐助夏雨雨人，帮助了许多学生。
examples.en: His donations came like summer rain and helped many students.

usage.en: The second 雨 is a verb read yǔ (to rain on, to water). Usually paired with 春风风人. Literary and formal; used in praise of kindness.
usage.zh: 第二个“雨”作动词，读 yù，意为“使……受到雨水滋润”。常与“春风风人”连用，书面语。

natural: a stove in summer, a fan in winter

meaning.en: Something out of season and useless; skills or ideas that are of no use now.
meaning.zh: 夏天用火炉、冬天用扇子，比喻不合时宜、没有用处的东西或言论。

equivalents: as useless as a stove in summer

examples.zh: 这种过时的方法就像夏炉冬扇，没人需要。
examples.en: This outdated method is like a stove in summer; nobody needs it.

examples.zh: 他的才能在这里是夏炉冬扇，派不上用场。
examples.en: His talents are out of season here and of no use.

examples.zh: 别提夏炉冬扇的建议了，现实不是这样的。
examples.en: Don't offer such out-of-date advice; reality is not like that.

story.en: Wang Chong writes that offering a ruler arguments out of season is like a stove in summer and a fan in winter (夏时炉，冬时扇).
story.zh: 王充《论衡·逢遇》：“夏时炉，冬时扇，以为不宜，暴之也。”

usage.en: Describes things that arrive at the wrong time or have no application. Related to 不合时宜. Literary.
usage.zh: 形容不合时宜、没有用处；与“不合时宜”相近。书面语。

natural: the beloved by the autumn water

meaning.en: Longing for someone dear who is far away, across the water.
meaning.zh: 秋日水边怀念心中的意中人，表达思念和追慕。

equivalents: longing for a distant loved one

examples.zh: 秋水伊人，他每到秋天就会想起远方的她。
examples.en: Every autumn he thought of her far away, like the loved one by the autumn water.

examples.zh: 这首歌写的是秋水伊人的思念。
examples.en: This song is about longing for the one by the autumn water.

examples.zh: 他在课文里学到了“秋水伊人”的意境。
examples.en: In the textbook he learned the mood of yearning across the autumn water.

usage.en: Poetic, drawing on the Book of Songs poem 蒹葭 ('the one I seek is on the other side of the water'). More a mood phrase than a fixed idiom; literary.
usage.zh: 诗意的说法，源自《诗经·蒹葭》“所谓伊人，在水一方”；偏重意境，书面语。

natural: harvest in autumn, store in winter

meaning.en: The farming year: gather the crops in autumn and store them in winter.
meaning.zh: 秋天收获，冬天储藏，指农事的节奏，也比喻按时节行事。

examples.zh: 农民们秋收冬藏，一年的辛苦终于有了回报。
examples.en: The farmers harvested in autumn and stored the grain in winter and were rewarded for a year's work.

examples.zh: 春生夏长，秋收冬藏，是自然的规律。
examples.en: Spring growth, summer ripening, autumn harvest and winter storage are nature's order.

examples.zh: 秋收冬藏的时候，村里家家忙着晒粮食。
examples.en: At harvest-and-storage time every household in the village was drying grain.

usage.en: Usually quoted with 春生夏长. Describes the cycle of the four seasons in farming; also used as a lesson in saving up for hard times.
usage.zh: 常与“春生夏长”连用，说明四季农事规律，也比喻平时积蓄、以备不时之需。

natural: autumn leaves, winter arrives

meaning.en: Autumn passes and winter comes; the passing of time.
meaning.zh: 秋天过去，冬天到来，形容时间流逝，季节更替。

examples.zh: 秋去冬来，树叶都落光了。
examples.en: Autumn passed and winter came, and the leaves have all fallen.

examples.zh: 转眼秋去冬来，我们已经认识一年了。
examples.en: Before we knew it autumn had passed and winter come and we had known each other for a year.

examples.zh: 秋去冬来，天气一天比一天冷。
examples.en: As autumn gives way to winter, the days get colder.

usage.en: A plain word group usually used to open a sentence about time passing. Compare 寒来暑往 and 春去秋来.
usage.zh: 普通词组，常用于开头，表示时间流逝；与“寒来暑往”“春去秋来”相近。

natural: autumn moon and spring breeze

meaning.en: The beautiful scenes of the seasons; also the passing of years.
meaning.zh: 秋天的明月，春天的和风，泛指美好的景色，也指岁月流逝。

examples.zh: 秋月春风，等闲度，何必伤感？
examples.en: With autumn moon and spring breeze idly passed, why grieve?

examples.zh: 诗人最爱写秋月春风。
examples.en: Poets love to write about the autumn moon and the spring wind.

examples.zh: 多少秋月春风过去了，故乡依旧。
examples.en: So many autumn moons and spring breezes have passed, but the hometown is unchanged.

usage.en: Poetic, often mentioned in Tang and Song verse, and sometimes with a wistful tone about time passing (春花秋月何时了). Literary.
usage.zh: 诗词中常见，有时带感慨时光流逝的意味。书面语。

natural: keep them warm in winter and cool in summer

meaning.en: To look after one's parents carefully, providing for their comfort in every season.
meaning.zh: 冬天使父母温暖，夏天使父母凉爽，泛指子女孝敬、照顾父母。

examples.zh: 他冬温夏清，把老母亲照顾得无微不至。
examples.en: He looked after his old mother with great care, warm in winter and cool in summer.

examples.zh: 古人强调为人子女要冬温夏清，昏定晨省。
examples.en: The ancients stressed that children should keep their parents comfortable and greet them morning and night.

examples.zh: 孝敬父母不是一句话，而是冬温夏清的行动。
examples.en: Honouring parents is not a slogan but the daily act of looking after them.

story.en: The Book of Rites says: 'A child should keep parents warm in winter and cool in summer, settle them at night and greet them at dawn' (冬温而夏清，昏定而晨省).
story.zh: 《礼记·曲礼上》：“凡为人子之礼，冬温而夏清，昏定而晨省。”

usage.en: 清 here is a form of 凊, read qìng, meaning 'cool'. Typically paired with 昏定晨省. Formal and traditional; used in teaching filial piety.
usage.zh: 此处“清”同“凊”，读 qìng，意为凉。常与“昏定晨省”连用，用于孝道教育。

natural: skin of ice and bones of jade

meaning.en: A fair, delicate complexion and a noble spirit; also a poetic image for plum blossom.
meaning.zh: 肌肤像冰一样清凉洁白，骨骼像玉一样温润，形容女子肌肤洁白、风姿高洁，也比喻梅花。

examples.zh: 画上的仕女冰肌玉骨，神态端庄。
examples.en: The lady in the painting has flawless skin and a dignified bearing.

examples.zh: 梅花冰肌玉骨，不惧严寒。
examples.en: The plum blossom is pure as ice and jade and fears no frost.

examples.zh: 她冰肌玉骨，像画里走出来的人。
examples.en: She is fair and delicate, as if stepped out of a painting.

usage.en: A poetic compliment for women and for plum blossom. Literary; too flowery for modern daily speech.
usage.zh: 对女子或梅花的诗意赞美，书面语，口语过于文雅。

natural: a clear breeze and bright moon

meaning.en: A pleasant, peaceful night with a cool breeze and a bright moon; also a clean and upright atmosphere.
meaning.zh: 清风徐来，明月当空，形容夜晚清爽宁静，也比喻环境清明、风气端正。

examples.zh: 今夜风清月朗，适合散步。
examples.en: Tonight the breeze is fresh and the moon bright, perfect for a walk.

examples.zh: 他们在风清月朗的夜晚谈心。
examples.en: They talked heart to heart on a clear, moonlit night.

examples.zh: 政治风气风清月朗，百姓安居乐业。
examples.en: The political climate is clean and the people live in peace.

usage.en: Often used in descriptions of scenery and, figuratively, a clean social climate. Literary.
usage.zh: 多用于写景，也可比喻风气清明；书面语。

natural: clouds on the mountain, fog all over

meaning.en: Vague and hard to grasp; speech or writing that leaves people in the dark.
meaning.zh: 云雾笼罩着山，比喻说话、写文章不着边际，叫人摸不着头脑。

examples.zh: 他讲得云山雾罩，大家都听不懂。
examples.en: He spoke so vaguely that nobody could follow.

examples.zh: 这篇文章写得云山雾罩，不知道想说什么。
examples.en: This article is so vague that I have no idea what it is trying to say.

examples.zh: 别云山雾罩的，直接说重点。
examples.en: Stop waffling and get to the point.

usage.en: Colloquial criticism of unclear writing or speech; originally describes mist on a mountain, which can also be literal.
usage.zh: 口语中批评说话写文章不清楚，也可字面描写山间云雾。

natural: the land in pieces

meaning.en: The country is divided and ruined by war or invasion.
meaning.zh: 国土被侵占分裂，国家残破不堪。

examples.zh: 抗战时期，山河破碎，百姓流离失所。
examples.en: During the War of Resistance the land lay in ruins and people were driven from their homes.

examples.zh: 面对山河破碎的局面，他决心救国。
examples.en: Facing the broken country, he vowed to save it.

examples.zh: 文天祥写下“山河破碎风飘絮”的诗句。
examples.en: Wen Tianxiang wrote the line about a broken land like windblown catkins.

story.en: Wen Tianxiang writes: 'The mountains and rivers are broken like windblown catkins, my life is adrift like rain-beaten duckweed' (山河破碎风飘絮，身世浮沉雨打萍).
story.zh: 文天祥《过零丁洋》：“山河破碎风飘絮，身世浮沉雨打萍。”

usage.en: Patriotic and sorrowful tone, usually about invasion or national crisis. Often seen with 国破家亡 and 风雨飘摇.
usage.zh: 带爱国悲愤色彩，多指国难。常与“国破家亡”并用。

natural: the land is so lovely

meaning.en: The country's rivers and mountains are beautiful; a phrase praising the homeland.
meaning.zh: 国家的山河十分美丽，是赞美祖国河山的话。

examples.zh: 江山多娇，值得我们好好保护。
examples.en: Our land is so lovely that it deserves to be well protected.

examples.zh: 旅行时看到祖国江山多娇，让人心生骄傲。
examples.en: Travelling and seeing the beauty of our land fills one with pride.

examples.zh: 祖国江山多娇，吸引着各地游客。
examples.en: Our country's landscape is so lovely that it draws visitors from everywhere.

usage.en: From Mao Zedong's poem 'Snow' ('江山如此多娇'). Often used in captions, essays and tour guides. A word group more than an idiom.
usage.zh: 出自毛泽东《沁园春·雪》“江山如此多娇”，常用于题词、作文和导游词。

natural: the mountains are high and the road is long

meaning.en: A long and difficult journey; often an excuse for seldom visiting.
meaning.zh: 山很高，路很远，指路途遥远艰难，常用来说明不容易见面。

equivalents: far away and hard to reach

examples.zh: 山高路远，我一年也回不了几次家。
examples.en: With the mountains high and the road long, I can go home only a few times a year.

examples.zh: 山高路远，请您多多保重。
examples.en: The road is long and far; please take good care.

examples.zh: 山高路远，送信的人走了三天才到。
examples.en: The mountains are high and the road long: the messenger took three days to arrive.

usage.en: A word group, plain and common; used both literally and as a polite sigh about distance. Compare 路遥马瘦.
usage.zh: 普通词组，常用于感叹路途遥远不便相见。

natural: the spring wind gently blows on people

meaning.en: To nourish and teach others as the spring wind gently warms things; generous help.
meaning.zh: 春风吹拂万物，比喻及时给人恩惠、教诲和温暖。

equivalents: to teach with a warm touch

examples.zh: 老师春风风人，夏雨雨人，教会了学生很多道理。
examples.en: The teacher was kind like spring wind and summer rain and taught the students much.

examples.zh: 他对员工总是春风风人，从不发脾气。
examples.en: He is always kind to his staff like a spring wind and never loses his temper.

examples.zh: 春风风人的教育方式让孩子更愿意学习。
examples.en: Gentle teaching makes children more willing to learn.

usage.en: The second 风 is a verb read fèng (to blow on, to nurture). Usually paired with 夏雨雨人. Literary; used about teachers and benefactors.
usage.zh: 第二个“风”作动词，读 fèng，意为吹拂、滋润。常与“夏雨雨人”连用，书面语。

natural: spring orchids and autumn chrysanthemums

meaning.en: Each has its own season of beauty; things that each excel in their own time.
meaning.zh: 春天的兰花、秋天的菊花，各有各的美，比喻人或事物各有所长，各擅胜场。

examples.zh: 两位画家春兰秋菊，风格不同却同样出色。
examples.en: The two painters are each excellent in their own way, with different styles.

examples.zh: 春兰秋菊，各有千秋，没必要比较。
examples.en: Orchids in spring and chrysanthemums in autumn each have their merit; there is no need to compare.

examples.zh: 校园里春兰秋菊，四季有花。
examples.en: On campus there are orchids in spring and chrysanthemums in autumn, with flowers all year.

usage.en: Often used to say two things cannot be ranked against each other. Literary; similar to 各有千秋.
usage.zh: 常说明两者各有长处、不必比较；书面语，与“各有千秋”相近。
